reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "a8ce6772b8b8f4a73b99fed180bbbcf2be0fea51: fix(controller): always set health.status.lastTransitionTime (#22665) (cherry-pick #22666) (#22667)…", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: The health.status.lastTransitionTime field on Application resources will now always be set with a timestamp value, whereas it was previously sometimes omitted.

proposed.statement: The Argo CD controller now consistently sets health.status.lastTransitionTime on Application resources, whereas previously this field was sometimes not set.
